methods.name: handleAddPlayer
methods.javadoc: Handles the creation of a nearby player entity, sets the position and held item

methods.name: handleAnimate
methods.javadoc: Renders a specified animation: Waking up a player, a living entity swinging its currently held item, being hurt or receiving a critical hit by normal or magical means

methods.name: handleAwardStats
methods.javadoc: Updates the players statistics or achievements

methods.name: handleBlockDestruction
methods.javadoc: Updates all registered IWorldAccess instances with destroyBlockInWorldPartially

methods.name: handleBlockEntityData
methods.javadoc: Updates the NBTTagCompound metadata of instances of the following entitytypes: Mob spawners, command blocks, beacons, skulls, flowerpot

methods.name: handleBlockEvent
methods.javadoc: Triggers Block.onBlockEventReceived, which is implemented in BlockPistonBase for extension/retraction, BlockNote for setting the instrument (including audiovisual feedback) and in BlockContainer to set the number of players accessing a (Ender)Chest

methods.name: handleBlockUpdate
methods.javadoc: Updates the block and metadata and generates a blockupdate (and notify the clients)

methods.name: handleChat
methods.javadoc: Prints a chatmessage in the chat GUI

methods.name: handleChunkBlocksUpdate
methods.javadoc: Received from the servers PlayerManager if between 1 and 64 blocks in a chunk are changed. If only one block requires an update, the server sends S23PacketBlockChange and if 64 or more blocks are changed, the server sends S21PacketChunkData

methods.name: handleCommandSuggestions
methods.javadoc: This method is only called for manual tab-completion (the {@link net.minecraft.command.arguments.SuggestionProviders#ASK_SERVER minecraft:ask_server} suggestion provider).

methods.name: handleContainerClose
methods.javadoc: Resets the ItemStack held in hand and closes the window that is opened

methods.name: handleContainerContent
methods.javadoc: Handles the placement of a specified ItemStack in a specified container/inventory slot

methods.name: handleContainerSetData
methods.javadoc: Sets the progressbar of the opened window to the specified value

methods.name: handleContainerSetSlot
methods.javadoc: Handles pickin up an ItemStack or dropping one in your inventory or an open (non-creative) container

methods.name: handleCustomPayload
methods.javadoc: Handles packets that have room for a channel specification. Vanilla implemented channels are "MC|TrList" to acquire a MerchantRecipeList trades for a villager merchant, "MC|Brand" which sets the server brand? on the player instance and finally "MC|RPack" which the server uses to communicate the identifier of the default server resourcepack for the client to load.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.javadoc: Closes the network channel

methods.name: handleEntityEvent
methods.javadoc: Invokes the entities' handleUpdateHealth method which is implemented in LivingBase (hurt/death), MinecartMobSpawner (spawn delay), FireworkRocket & MinecartTNT (explosion), IronGolem (throwing,...), Witch (spawn particles), Zombie (villager transformation), Animal (breeding mode particles), Horse (breeding/smoke particles), Sheep (...), Tameable (...), Villager (particles for breeding mode, angry and happy), Wolf (...)

methods.name: handleExplosion
methods.javadoc: Initiates a new explosion (sound, particles, drop spawn) for the affected blocks indicated by the packet.

methods.name: handleLevelChunk
methods.javadoc: Updates the specified chunk with the supplied data, marks it for re-rendering and lighting recalculation

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.javadoc: Registers some server properties (gametype,hardcore-mode,terraintype,difficulty,player limit), creates a new WorldClient and sets the player initial dimension

methods.name: handleMapItemData
methods.javadoc: Updates the worlds MapStorage with the specified MapData for the specified map-identifier and invokes a MapItemRenderer for it

methods.name: handleMoveEntity
methods.javadoc: Updates the specified entity's position by the specified relative moment and absolute rotation. Note that subclassing of the packet allows for the specification of a subset of this data (e.g. only rel. position, abs. rotation or both).

methods.name: handleOpenSignEditor
methods.javadoc: Creates a sign in the specified location if it didn't exist and opens the GUI to edit its text

methods.name: handleParticleEvent
methods.javadoc: Spawns a specified number of particles at the specified location with a randomized displacement according to specified bounds

methods.name: handleRotateMob
methods.javadoc: Updates the direction in which the specified entity is looking, normally this head rotation is independent of the rotation of the entity itself

methods.name: handleSetCarriedItem
methods.javadoc: Updates which hotbar slot of the player is currently selected

methods.name: handleSetDisplayObjective
methods.javadoc: Removes or sets the ScoreObjective to be displayed at a particular scoreboard position (list, sidebar, below name)

methods.name: handleSetEntityData
methods.javadoc: Invoked when the server registers new proximate objects in your watchlist or when objects in your watchlist have changed -> Registers any changes locally

methods.name: handleSetEntityMotion
methods.javadoc: Sets the velocity of the specified entity to the specified value

methods.name: handleSetPlayerTeamPacket
methods.javadoc: Updates a team managed by the scoreboard: Create/Remove the team registration, Register/Remove the player-team-memberships, Set team displayname/prefix/suffix and/or whether friendly fire is enabled

methods.name: handleSetScore
methods.javadoc: Either updates the score with a specified value or removes the score for an objective

methods.name: handleTeleportEntity
methods.javadoc: Updates an entity's position and rotation as specified by the packet

methods.name: handleUpdateAttributes
methods.javadoc: Updates en entity's attributes and their respective modifiers, which are used for speed bonusses (player sprinting, animals fleeing, baby speed), weapon/tool attackDamage, hostiles followRange randomization, zombie maxHealth and knockback resistance as well as reinforcement spawning chance.

net/minecraft/network/protocol/game/Serv.javadoc: PacketListener for the server side of the PLAY protocol.

methods.name: handleChat
methods.javadoc: Process chat messages (broadcast back to clients) and commands (executes)

methods.name: handleClientCommand
methods.javadoc: Processes the client status updates: respawn attempt from player, opening statistics or achievements, or acquiring 'open inventory' achievement

methods.name: handleClientInformation
methods.javadoc: Updates serverside copy of client settings: language, render distance, chat visibility, chat colours, difficulty, and whether to show the cape

methods.name: handleContainerButtonClick
methods.javadoc: Enchants the item identified by the packet given some convoluted conditions (matching window, which should/shouldn't be in use?)

methods.name: handleContainerClick
methods.javadoc: Executes a container/inventory slot manipulation as indicated by the packet. Sends the serverside result if they didn't match the indicated result and prevents further manipulation by the player until he confirms that it has the same open container/inventory

methods.name: handleContainerClose
methods.javadoc: Processes the client closing windows (container)

methods.name: handleCustomCommandSuggestions
methods.javadoc: This method is only called for manual tab-completion (the {@link net.minecraft.command.arguments.SuggestionProviders#ASK_SERVER minecraft:ask_server} suggestion provider).

methods.name: handleCustomPayload
methods.javadoc: Synchronizes serverside and clientside book contents and signing

methods.name: handleInteract
methods.javadoc: Processes left and right clicks on entities

methods.name: handleKeepAlive
methods.javadoc: Updates a players' ping statistics

methods.name: handleMovePlayer
methods.javadoc: Processes clients perspective on player positioning and/or orientation

methods.name: handlePlayerAbilities
methods.javadoc: Processes a player starting/stopping flying

methods.name: handlePlayerAction
methods.javadoc: Processes the player initiating/stopping digging on a particular spot, as well as a player dropping items

methods.name: handlePlayerCommand
methods.javadoc: Processes a range of action-types: sneaking, sprinting, waking from sleep, opening the inventory or setting jump height of the horse the player is riding

methods.name: handlePlayerInput
methods.javadoc: Processes player movement input. Includes walking, strafing, jumping, sneaking" excludes riding and toggling flying/sprinting

methods.name: handleSetCarriedItem
